name: Tamago de Puzzle
summary: Tamago de Puzzle is a puzzle game based on another Sony game Hermie Hopperhead, as the main character and the rest of the game theme and characters are taken from that game. The game itself is a competitive puzzle game, where you drop combinations of eggs at two at a time and cause blocks to appear on your opponent's screen. There's also a full story mode with even more animated cutscenes.
